resolutions.researcher_notes: Status=operating. This row is the Shedgum-Riyadh Gas Pipeline 2 (40 km of 56-inch) built under Aramco Master Gas System Expansion (MGSE) Phase 2, Package 3 (Eastern Region Pipeline). Blackridge Research: MGS-2 EPC works 'completed in 2021,' raising capacity from 8.4 to 12.5 bcf/d. DMS Projects lists project status 'Completed' with scope '40 kilometers of 56 inch pipeline on the Shedgum Riyadh Gas 2.' Two independent sources confirm the line is built and in service -> operating supported.

StartYear1=2021. Blackridge Research states MGS-2 'started in 2015' and 'EPC works were completed in 2021,' directly supporting a 2021 operating start. CONTRADICTION TO FLAG: the Lamar Industrial contractor page (EP-scope) gives 'Awarded 2015, Completed 2018' for its detailed-design/procurement portion of Package III; that 2018 is the EP milestone, not overall commissioning, and the whole MGS-2 program came online in 2021 per Blackridge. 2021 is the correct operating year but only one strong independent source pins it -> medium.

SegmentCost=117,000,000 USD. Lamar Industrial's Package III (Eastern Region Pipeline) page states a contract value of 'USD 118.53 million' for the EP scope covering the two 56-inch lines (SRG-3 ~150 km and SRG-2 SEC III ~40 km) -> supports the ~$117M figure (essentially agrees, ~1.3% off). CONTRADICTION TO FLAG: other sources report much larger totals at a different granularity - DMS/MEED search cite the full Package 3 at 'over $372 million' and Arkad's three MGS-2 pipeline packages at an estimated USD 1.3 billion; the $117M is the segment/EP-contract slice, not the full package. Single working source at this granularity -> medium.
